Tippa_Jyotivid
or Tippaṇa, son of Gauraṇa.
--Uparāgadarpaṇa. Luck. Uni. p. 53.

Tippādīkṣita
father of Cokkanātha (a. of Kāntimatīpariṇaya. NCC. VII. p. 85a an. Sevantikāpariṇaya); teacher of Nārāyaṇa (a. of Adbhutapañjara, NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 116b) an. of Mṛtyuñjaya (a. of Pradyumnottaracarita,
); belonged to a Telugu family; master of four Śāstras, an. one of the recipients of the gift of Tiruviśanallūr agrahāra from Sāhaji in 1693 A. D. See Intro. to Śāhendravilāsa, p. 37 ff.

Tippābhaṭṭa
son of Ciṭṭibhaṭṭa Vādīndra.
--Lakṣaṇarāji or Lakṣaṇāvali. ny.

Tippū
or tippAbhaTTa surnamed Gahvara, son of Rāma Bhaṭṭa an. grandson of Bālam Bhaṭṭa.
--Agniṣṭomasya Saptahautraprayogaḥ or Hautrikaprayogaḥ. AS. p. 241. [Page179-a.
--C. Saṅgrahadīpikā on Āśvalāyanaśrautasūtra. Written a. Benares in 1776 A. D. Alph. List Beng. Govt. p. 123. C..
